label: False Idols
release_notes: Bristol producer Adrian Thaws' 15th studio album and first full-length under his own name in six years, on his own False Idols label.
Bristol singer Mitch Sanders, 22, sings top lines on 12 of 14 tracks in a high falsetto; guests also include Marta Złakowska, Radana and Run Red Rambo.
Reviewers note distorted guitars, hypnotic basslines and electronic textures, with Tricky's low growl underneath.
Label not in the Zookeeper label table.

pull_quotes.text: working with some of the best instrumentals of his career

draft_comment: Tricky's best in years. Dark, guitar-heavy Bristol trip-hop, with Mitch Sanders' ghostly falsetto doing a lot of the heavy lifting.
